controls.label: Shape model
controls.description: JPL radar shape model of 1999 KW 4 Beta, with finite resolution and uneven radar coverage. The original mesh is retained before simplification. Display phase is arbitrary; libration is not reproduced. The grid marks unmapped visible-light terrain. Later mutual-event photometry favors roughly 1.3 times the original radar model’s linear scale. This view retains the original 2006 mesh dimensions.
controls.title: Radar shape model
